card.summary: Save a note that outlives this run and session.

spec.description: Save a short note to cross-session memory: a user preference, a project convention, a fact worth knowing next time. Notes are never injected automatically; a later run finds them with memory.note.search.

text.description: The note, one self-contained sentence or two.

tags.description: Optional labels to search by later.

spec.usage_notes: Save what a future session could not rediscover on its own. Do not save transcript details.

discovery.kernel_note: Facts worth keeping across sessions go to memory.note.save; look them up with memory.note.search before asking the user again.

card.summary: Search notes saved by earlier runs and sessions.

spec.description: Search cross-session memory. Returns the best-matching notes with their tags and when they were saved; only what you search for enters the context.

query.description: What to look for, in natural language.
